verifications.claim: Alex Bowman has been medically cleared to return to the No. 48 Hendrick Motorsports Chevrolet for the NASCAR Cup Series race at Bristol Motor Speedway.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Bowman will drive the No. 48 Chevrolet on Sunday at the Tennessee track'; R2: 'Bowman will return for the Food City 500 NASCAR Cup Series race on April 12 at the half-mile oval'; R3: 'Alex Bowman, driver of the No. 48 Ally Chevrolet for Hendrick Motorsports, has been medically cleared to return to competition and will race in Sunday’s NASCAR Cup Series event at Bristol Motor Speedway'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state Bowman is medically cleared to drive the No. 48 for Hendrick at Bristol Cup race.

verifications.claim: Alex Bowman missed four races due to vertigo symptoms.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'missing four races with vertigo'; R2: 'missing four races while recovering from vertigo'; R3: 'has missed starts at Phoenix Raceway, Las Vegas Motor Speedway, Darlington Raceway and Martinsville Speedway while recovering from vertigo'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly confirm Bowman missed exactly four races due to vertigo.

verifications.claim: Alex Bowman completed simulator work and physical evaluations to confirm his recovery.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'practicing pit stops, racing in a simulator and passing a medical evaluation'; R2: 'simulator work and pit stop practice... received a medical evaluation'; R3: 'pit stop practice, simulator testing and a medical evaluation'
verifications.reasoning: All references detail simulator work/testing and medical evaluations as part of clearance process.

verifications.claim: Alex Bowman's return race is Bristol Motor Speedway (Food City 500) on April 12, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'return to the NASCAR race weekend at Bristol Motor Speedway... on Sunday'; R2: 'return for the Food City 500... on April 12 at [Bristol]'; R3: 'return to competition and will race in Sunday’s NASCAR Cup Series event at Bristol Motor Speedway'
verifications.reasoning: All confirm Bristol as return race; R2 specifies Food City 500 on April 12, 2026, consistent with others' Sunday reference.

verifications.claim: Vertigo symptoms first forced Alex Bowman out of the car at Circuit of the Americas (COTA) on March 1.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'exit his car during the March 1 race at Circuit of the Americas because of the symptoms of vertigo'; R2: 'exited out of the No. 48 Chevrolet during the March 1 race at COTA with vertigo symptoms'; R3: 'began experiencing symptoms during the March 1 event at Circuit of The Americas before exiting the car'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state vertigo first caused exit from car at COTA on March 1.

verifications.claim: Alex Bowman missed races at Phoenix, Las Vegas, Darlington, and Martinsville.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Anthony Alfredo replaced Bowman at Phoenix, and Justin Allgaier has driven the past three races'; R2: 'missed races at Phoenix, Las Vegas, Darlington and Martinsville'; R3: 'missed starts at Phoenix Raceway, Las Vegas Motor Speedway, Darlington Raceway and Martinsville Speedway'
verifications.reasoning: R2 and R3 list exact races; R1 confirms Phoenix and three subsequent races consistent with list.

verifications.claim: Justin Allgaier, Anthony Alfredo, and Myatt Snider filled in as substitute drivers during Alex Bowman's absence.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'replaced by Myatt Snider that day [COTA]. Anthony Alfredo replaced Bowman at Phoenix, and Justin Allgaier has driven the past three races'; R3: 'Justin Allgaier drove... at Las Vegas, Darlington and Martinsville. Anthony Alfredo filled in at Phoenix'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R3 name all three drivers and their specific races/substitutions matching Bowman's absence.

verifications.claim: Alex Bowman expressed readiness to return after focusing on his recovery.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '“It’s been tough being out of the car, but we all wanted to make sure I was 100% ready before returning... I feel really good, and I’m excited”'; R3: '“It’s been tough being out of the car, but we all wanted to make sure I was 100% ready before returning. I feel really good, and I’m excited about... getting back to racing”'
verifications.reasoning: Bowman's direct quotes in R1 and R3 express feeling good, 100% ready, and excitement to return post-recovery.

verifications.evidence: R1: '“From the outset, our goal was to prioritize his health and have him return when he was fully recovered and medically cleared”'; R3: '“From the outset, our goal was to prioritize his health and have him return when he was fully recovered and medically cleared”'
